answer: Plant honeypot counterparties offering bait trades no independent agent would take in lockstep — a jade-grade deal so sweet the sybil farmer's script grabs it across every puppet at once. Like lures on a reef, decoys look profitable but silently fingerprint identical acceptance; honest agents wander in one by one, each with different needs, never in formation. Taking a decoy triggers clawback plus standing loss, so the farmer's cheap coordination becomes the tripwire: the more puppets bite, the deeper the loss. Sybil scale turns self-defeating — its own uniformity betrays it.
